decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as Class B8 Wholesale Warehouse and shall not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 5 - The premises shall be used for Class B8 Wholesale Warehouse and for no other purpose.
Condition : 6 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - Loading and unloading of goods and materials shall not take place anywhere on the site except within building[s].
Condition : 8 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - No machinery shall be operated, no process shall be carried out and no deliveries taken at or despatched from the site outside the following times 7.00am to 5.00pm Mondays to Fridays and 8.00am Saturdays to 1.00pm nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 10 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 7.00am to 5.00pm on Mondays to Friday and 8.00am to 1.00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 11 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.
Condition : 12 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 13 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 14 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 2230/02 and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 15 - The access doorway to the premises shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Change of use from B1 (Light Industry) to B8 (Wholesale Warehouse) with associated office and parking.
